title: Pool Fill Water Anomaly From Leak
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watermeter:flow
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=0 AND hour<6
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(flow_gal) as overnight_flow_gal by meter _time
| where overnight_flow_gal>200
| sort - overnight_flow_gal
description: Uses Whole-home water-flow data telemetry to monitor large overnight draw that often points to filling or leakage in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for water loss hiding behind sleeping hours, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Whole-home water-flow data data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It blends large overnight draw that often points to filling or leakage so you can spot water loss hiding behind sleeping hours before it becomes annoying.
